definitions.explanation: formally filing a criminal complaint with prosecutors or police by the victim of a crime

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{告訴|こくそ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧{罪|ざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{告訴|こくそ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{告訴|こくそ} is a legal term referring to the formal act of a crime victim filing a criminal complaint with authorities.

WRITING:
- {告|こく} (announce, tell, accuse)
- {訴|そ} (sue, complain, accuse)

USAGE:
- {告訴|こくそ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to press charges, to file a complaint - suru verb)
- {告訴|こくそ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{下|さ}げる (to drop charges)
- {告訴|こくそ}{状|じょう} (written complaint)

LEGAL DISTINCTION:
- {告訴|こくそ}: filed by the VICTIM of the crime
- ⟦{告発|こくはつ}→告発：07999_kokuhatsu⟧: filed by a THIRD PARTY (anyone, not necessarily the victim)
- This distinction is important in Japanese criminal law

KEY CONCEPTS:
- {親告罪|しんこくざい} (crimes prosecutable only upon complaint) - some crimes require the victim's {告訴|こくそ} to prosecute
- {告訴|こくそ}{権|けん} (right to file charges)
- {告訴|こくそ}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (period for filing charges)

COMMON CHARGES:
- ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{告訴|こくそ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to charge with fraud)
- ⟦{名誉毀損|めいよきそん}→名誉毀損：17874_meiyokison⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{告訴|こくそ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to charge with defamation)
- ⟦{窃盗|せっとう}→窃盗：15280_settou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{告訴|こくそ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to charge with theft)

- ⟦{起訴|きそ}→起訴：10577_kiso⟧ (indictment, prosecution)
